description: Backend lab persistence: Django Lab model + migration, LabSerializer/LabListSerializer, DRF generics CRUD views scoped to the owner, URL routes, and authorization/CRUD tests. Reuses the global IsAuthenticated default and the custom exception handler so error responses match the frontend apiFetch format. Does not touch the simulation endpoints.
steps: 1. Replace services/api/apps/labs/models.py placeholder with the Lab model: id=UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False); owner=ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=CASCADE, related_name='labs') (import settings from django.conf); name=CharField(max_length=200); description=TextField(blank=True, default=''); topology=JSONField(default=dict) (comment: React Flow canvas {nodes, edges}); created_at=DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True); updated_at=DateTimeField(auto_now=True); Meta.ordering=['-updated_at']; __str__ returns self.name.

2. Run `cd services/api && python manage.py makemigrations labs --settings=netlab.settings.dev` (creates apps/labs/migrations/0001_initial.py depending on accounts) then `python manage.py migrate --settings=netlab.settings.dev`.

3. Append to services/api/apps/labs/serializers.py after PingRequestSerializer: LabSerializer(ModelSerializer) with fields ['id','name','description','topology','created_at','updated_at','owner_name'], read_only_fields ['id','created_at','updated_at','owner_name'], owner_name=CharField(source='owner.full_name', read_only=True). LabListSerializer(ModelSerializer) with fields ['id','name','description','created_at','updated_at','device_count','link_count'], read_only_fields ['id','created_at','updated_at','device_count','link_count'], device_count=SerializerMethodField (len(obj.topology.get('nodes', []))), link_count=SerializerMethodField (len(obj.topology.get('edges', []))) — guard against non-dict topology.

4. Append to services/api/apps/labs/views.py: import generics from rest_framework, Lab from .models, LabSerializer+LabListSerializer from .serializers. LabListCreateView(generics.ListCreateAPIView): permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated], pagination_class=None, get_queryset returns Lab.objects.filter(owner=self.request.user), get_serializer_class returns LabListSerializer for GET else LabSerializer, perform_create calls serializer.save(owner=self.request.user). LabDetailView(generics.RetrieveUpdateDestroyAPIView): permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated], get_queryset returns Lab.objects.filter(owner=self.request.user), serializer_class=LabSerializer, lookup_url_kwarg='lab_id', lookup_field='id'.

5. Add to services/api/apps/labs/urls.py urlpatterns (import the two new views): path('labs/', LabListCreateView.as_view(), name='lab-list-create') and path('labs/<uuid:lab_id>/', LabDetailView.as_view(), name='lab-detail'). Parent netlab/api/urls.py include under 'labs/' is unchanged.

6. Create services/api/apps/labs/tests/test_lab_crud.py using django.test.TestCase + rest_framework.test.APIClient + apps.accounts.models.User + apps.labs.models.Lab. Use client.force_authenticate(user=...). Cover: create returns 201 owned by user; list returns only caller's labs (two-user isolation); retrieve returns topology + owner_name==user.full_name; PATCH updates name+topology; DELETE returns 204 and lab gone; list items have device_count/link_count and no topology; unauthenticated returns 401; non-owner GET/PATCH/DELETE returns 404 (queryset filter).
acceptance_criteria: apps/labs/migrations/0001_initial.py exists and `python manage.py migrate --settings=netlab.settings.dev` succeeds
`python -m pytest apps/labs/tests/ -q` passes (new CRUD tests + the 15 existing adapter tests)
`cd packages/simulator-core && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:django` still passes (438 tests, untouched)
GET /api/v1/labs/labs/ returns a plain array (no pagination envelope) of the caller's labs; non-owner UUIDs return 404; unauthenticated returns 401
verification: cd services/api && python manage.py makemigrations labs --settings=netlab.settings.dev
cd packages/simulator-core && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:django
findings: FEAT-001 complete. Endpoints (mounted under /api/v1/labs/): GET and POST /api/v1/labs/labs/ and GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/labs/labs/<uuid:lab_id>/ (lookup_url_kwarg='lab_id', uuid path converter). Lab model fields (exact names): id (UUIDField pk, uuid4, editable=False), owner (FK settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL CASCADE, related_name='labs'), name (CharField max 200), description (TextField blank default ''), topology (JSONField default=dict), created_at (auto_now_add), updated_at (auto_now). Meta.ordering=['-updated_at'] so list returns newest-updated first. LabSerializer (used for create/retrieve/update/detail) response field names (exact): id, name, description, topology, created_at, updated_at, owner_name. owner_name is read-only via source='owner.full_name' (User has full_name @property returning first+last trimmed). topology is stored as the raw React Flow canvas document shaped {nodes, edges} (NOT the simulator TopologyDocument and NOT convertFlowToTopology output) so opening a saved lab restores node positions; device_count=len(topology.nodes), link_count=len(topology.edges) with guards for non-dict topology. LabListSerializer list item field names (exact): id, name, description, created_at, updated_at, device_count, link_count. List items have NO topology and NO owner_name. The list view sets pagination_class=None and returns a PLAIN ARRAY (no pagination envelope). DELETE returns 204 No Content. Authorization: both views filter get_queryset by owner=request.user, so a non-owner GET/PATCH/DELETE on a real UUID returns 404 (not 403); unauthenticated returns 401. All DRF errors are wrapped by netlab.api.exception_handler.custom_exception_handler into {error:{code,message,detail?}} with codes authentication_required (401), not_found (404), validation_error (400) — matches the frontend apiFetch throw shape. ENVIRONMENT NOTE for FEAT-002 verification: pytest-django 4.9.0 is installed ONLY in the project venv at services/venv/Scripts/python.exe; the bare 'python' on PATH resolves to system Python WITHOUT pytest-django and the labs tests will fail to collect there. Run backend pytest with the venv interpreter explicitly: services/venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest apps/labs/tests/ -q (cwd services/api). manage.py makemigrations/migrate/check worked with system python too, but prefer the venv for consistency.
